name: Cully
description: Gemini-powered batch photo culling with Streamlit and LangGraph.

GOOGLE_API_KEY.description: Gemini API key used to assess uploaded photos.

ARIZE_SPACE_ID.description: Optional Arize AX space ID for tracing.

ARIZE_API_KEY.description: Optional Arize AX API key for tracing.

GEMINI_MODEL.description: Gemini model used for photo assessment.

GEMINI_MIN_INTERVAL.description: Minimum delay between Gemini calls, in seconds.

GEMINI_MAX_IMAGE_EDGE.description: Maximum prepared image edge, in pixels.

GEMINI_MAX_ATTEMPTS.description: Maximum attempts for retryable Gemini errors.
